paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of two LLM variants, Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom), on a 5-digit multiplication task as a function of initial confidence. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence", ranges from 0.91 to 0.98 and is presented on a linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The top line, representing Llama4 Scout, is blue with solid lines and circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.85 at an initial confidence of 0.91, rising to a peak of 1.0 at 0.92, then remaining near 1.0 across the rest of the range down to 0.98. The bottom line, representing Llama4 Maverick, is green with dashed lines and square markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.2 at 0.91, declining to a low of approximately 0.07 at 0.92, then steadily increasing to approximately 0.85 at 0.98. The orange dashed line with diamond markers, which appears to represent the average or a reference curve, starts at approximately 0.65 at 0.91, peaks at approximately 0.92, and then declines to approximately 0.1 at 0.98. Error bars are present for all data points, indicating variability.
